title: The Guru's Word, I Have Attained
summary: Patience is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: Through the Guru's Word, I have attained the supreme status
lifeApplication: Wait by listening instead of simmering. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.shortMeaning: Through the Guru's Word, I have attained the supreme status
source.lifeApplication: Wait by listening instead of simmering. Let the line meet the ordinary room before self-judgment starts arranging it.

evidence.coreClaim: Through the Guru's Word, I have attained the supreme status
evidence.turn: Keep returning to this turn: O Nanak, meeting with the Guru, I have found the Supreme Lord God.
evidence.practicalImplication: Wait by listening instead of simmering. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.
